description: PSP-side degradation on PIX in Brazil, confirmed by the provider status page and two merchant reports.

evidence.text: PSP Acme status page: DEGRADED PERFORMANCE on PIX settlement since 09:58 UTC. Engineers are investigating elevated timeouts at the clearing layer. No ETA yet.
Merchant LojaVerde reports customers seeing 'payment failed' on PIX checkout since about 10:00 UTC. Card payments on the same checkout are unaffected.
#apm-latam: three different merchants pinged us about PIX in the last ten minutes. Nothing shipped on our side today, last deploy was Friday.
